question: Which is the correct spelling of a word meaning ‘self-governance’?
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The correct spelling of the word meaning ‘self-governance’ is ‘Autonomy’.**

__
 
• **‘Autonomy’** is a **noun** which means the right or condition of self-government, particularly in a specific sphere. **(स्वायत्तता)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The country gained autonomy from its colonial rulers.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **‘Autonomy’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let’s understand why the other options are incorrect:**

 
• **Autonommy -** This is an incorrect spelling with an extra ‘m’.
 
• **Autonaumy -** This is an incorrect spelling with a misplaced ‘a’ instead of ‘o’.
 
• **Autonamy -** This is an incorrect spelling with an incorrect replacement of ‘o’ with ‘a’.

3a:T695,

The correct answer is option 2.</st
